GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
